model_annotation: This plot illustrates the values of two datasets across a series of categories. The x-axis is labeled "中介网络" (intermediary network) and displays six categories: A1, A2, B1, B2, C1, and C2, with a regularly spaced interval. The y-axis is labeled "网络" (network) and has a linear scale ranging from 3.5 to 5.5, with tick labels at 3.5, 4.5, and 5.5. A red, dashed line with triangular markers represents one dataset, starting at 3.254 at A1 and increasing to 3.685 at 母亲 (mother). This line exhibits a decline from 3.254 at A1 to 3.179 at B1, followed by an increase to 3.304 at B2, a decline to 3.278 at C1, an increase to 3.420 at C2, and a final increase to 3.685 at 母亲. A blue line with 'x' markers represents the second dataset, starting at 4.030 at A1 and increasing to 4.613 at 母亲. This line decreases from 4.030 at A1 to 3.956 at A2, increases to 4.188 at B1, decreases to 3.865 at B2, increases to 4.265 at C1, decreases to 3.903 at C2, and increases to 4.613 at 母亲.
